records.jp: ――ふう
records.en_original: Phew...
records.en: Phew...

records.jp: それでは……<CR>お話しします。私が知りうる限りのことを
records.en_original: Now, then... I'll tell you everything I know.
records.en: Now, then... I'll tell you everything I know.

records.jp: う、うん
records.en_original: I-I'm ready.
records.en: I-I'm ready.

records.jp: あの構造物について話す前に、<CR>まずかつての私の目的について明らかにしておきます
records.en_original: Before we talk about that structure, there's something you must know about my former ambitions.
records.en: Before we talk about that structure, there's something you must know about my former ambitions.

records.jp: かつての私の目的……<CR>それは、世界を理想の形に作り替えることでした
records.en_original: My original goal...was to remake the world as I pleased.
records.en: My original goal...was to remake the world as I pleased.

records.jp: 理想の形……？
records.en_original: As you pleased...?
records.en: As you pleased...?

records.jp: 想いだとか絆だとか……<CR>そういう理解できないものが存在しない世界です
records.en_original: A world without feelings, bonds...or any of the other things I couldn't comprehend.
records.en: A world without feelings, bonds...or any of the other things I couldn't comprehend.

records.jp: それを成し遂げるのが、あの構造物――<CR>私は、「オリジン」と呼んでいました
records.en_original: That structure was created in order to achieve that... I called it Origin.
records.en: That structure was created in order to achieve that... I called it Origin.

records.jp: オリジン……
records.en_original: Origin...
records.en: Origin...

records.jp: オリジンは、私たちが暮らしている<CR>世界、概念、そのすべてを創造する存在です
records.en_original: Origin is the creator of this world we live in, its laws, and everything in it.
records.en: Origin is the creator of this world we live in, its laws, and everything in it.

records.jp: な、なんだそりゃ……？
records.en_original: Wh-what...?
records.en: Wh-what...?

records.jp: そう。人間からすればまったく理解できない
records.en_original: Exactly. The human mind is incapable of comprehending it.
records.en: Exactly. The human mind is incapable of comprehending it.

records.jp: どこにあるのかも分からない、<CR>何がどうなって世界を創造しているのかも分からない
records.en_original: We don't know where it exists, or how it created the world.
records.en: We don't know where it exists, or how it created the world.

records.jp: それが、オリジンです
records.en_original: That is Origin.
records.en: That is Origin.

records.jp: オリジン……
records.en_original: Origin...
records.en: Origin...

records.jp: みなさんが世界システムと<CR>呼んでいた存在がいますよね？
records.en_original: There's something you all refer to as the World System, correct?
records.en: There's something you all refer to as the World System, correct?

records.jp: う、うん。私たちを襲う、敵……なのかな？
records.en_original: Yeah. It's our enemy, I guess you could say.
records.en: Yeah. It's our enemy, I guess you could say.

records.jp: 私の考えだと、<CR>あれもオリジンに由来する何かだと思います
records.en_original: If I had to guess, I'd say that it's also somehow connected to Origin.
records.en: If I had to guess, I'd say that it's also somehow connected to Origin.

records.jp: ……オリジンは、<CR>世界システムのさらに上位に存在する神？
records.en_original: So Origin is something even more powerful than the World System?
records.en: So Origin is something even more powerful than the World System?

records.jp: かもしれません。……ただ、<CR>言った通りこれは私の考えでしかない
records.en_original: Perhaps. But as I said, it's just a hypothesis.
records.en: Perhaps. But as I said, it's just a hypothesis.

records.jp: 本当のところがどうなのかなんて、<CR>人間には分からないんです
records.en_original: The truth of the matter is beyond human understanding.
records.en: The truth of the matter is beyond human understanding.

records.jp: “世界システム＝オリジン”なのかもしれないし、<CR>逆に世界システムがオリジンを生んだのかもしれない
records.en_original: It's possible that the World System and Origin are one and the same. Or perhaps it was the World System that created Origin.
records.en: It's possible that the World System and Origin are one and the same. Or perhaps it was the World System that created Origin.

records.jp: オリジンという名前ですら、<CR>私がそう呼んでいただけなんです
records.en_original: Even the name Origin is simply my own name for it. I don't know what it's really called.
records.en: Even the name Origin is simply my own name for it. I don't know what it's really called.

records.jp: それこそ……金城さん
records.en_original: Speaking of... Yuki.
records.en: Speaking of... Kinjou-san.

records.jp: は、はいっ
records.en_original: Y-yes?
records.en: Y-yes?

records.jp: 金城さんは、自分がいるからみんなが<CR>危険に晒されるとおっしゃっていましたが……
records.en_original: You mentioned that everyone is in danger because of your presence here...
records.en: Kinjou-san, you said that everyone was in danger because you were here, but...

records.jp: 実際のところ、それも金城さん……<CR>人間の目線からの話でしかないわけです
records.en_original: The truth is, that's only true from your own, human, perspective.
records.en: The truth is, that's only true from your own, human, perspective.

records.jp: 金城さんは亡くなっていて、<CR>世界システムの力でこの世界に蘇った。それは事実
records.en_original: Yuki was dead, and the World System brought her back. That's a fact.
records.en: Kinjou-san was dead, and the World System brought her back. That's a fact.

records.jp: でもその目的が何なのかは、金城さんも<CR>想像して語ることしかできない。違いますか？
records.en_original: But even Yuki can only guess as to why and for what purpose. Is that right?
records.en: But even Kinjou-san can only guess as to why and for what purpose. Is that right?

records.jp: ……そういえば、あの時言っていました――
records.en_original: Come to think of it, she did mention something like that...
records.en: Come to think of it, she did mention something like that...

records.jp: な、なんで世界システムは、<CR>そんなことしたんですか…………！？
records.en_original: Wh-why would the World System do such a thing?!
records.en: Wh-why would the World System do such a thing?!

records.jp: さあ？　あたしは神の考えることなんて分かんない
records.en_original: Who knows? How can I possibly understand how god thinks.
records.en: Who knows? How can I possibly understand how god thinks.

records.jp: そっか。それは、そうかもしれない……
records.en_original: Come to think of it, you might be right...
records.en: Come to think of it, you might be right...

records.jp: そういうものがあるんだと納得するしかない。<CR>私たちが相手にしているのは、そういう存在です
records.en_original: We have to accept that this is what we are facing.
records.en: We have to accept that this is what we are facing.

records.jp: 神を相手にする、か…………
records.en_original: Facing god...
records.en: Facing god...

records.jp: ただ一つ……たった一つだけ分かっていることがある。<CR>オリジンは、世界を創造する存在だということです
records.en_original: There is only one thing I know for certain: Origin is the creator of this world.
records.en: There is only one thing I know for certain: Origin is the creator of this world.

records.jp: う、詩さんはどうしてそれを知ってるの？<CR>人間には理解できない存在なんだよね……？
records.en_original: But how can you know for sure, Uta? Didn't you say yourself it's beyond human comprehension?
records.en: But how can you know for sure, Uta-san? Didn't you say yourself it's beyond human comprehension?

records.jp: 神のことは神にしか分からない……<CR>私は、原種からその情報を得ました
records.en_original: Only a god can comprehend a god... I learned it from the Sephira.
records.en: Only a god can comprehend a god... I learned it from the Sephira.

records.jp: 原種――
records.en_original: The Sephira...
records.en: The Sephira...

records.jp: 詩ちゃんが言っている「神」と、<CR>ライムたちが言っている「神」はちょっと違うんだ
records.en_original: What Uta considers a god and what we consider a god are slightly different.
records.en: The 'Divine' Uta-chan speaks of is slightly different from the 'Divine' Lime and Yuzu mean.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんが言っている神は原種のこと。<CR>ヒナちゃんがリフレクトしたものと同等の存在だね
records.en_original: The gods Uta is referring to are the Sephira. The same beings Hina Reflected.
records.en: The gods Uta-chan is referring to are the Sephira. The same beings Hina-chan Reflected.

records.jp: ……ユズとライムが言ってた。<CR>詩さんが持っていたっていう原種の力……
records.en_original: ...Yuzu and Lime did say you had the power of a Sephira...
records.en: ...Yuzu and Lime said it too—the Sephira power you possessed, Uta-san...

records.jp: はい、そうです
records.en_original: Yes, that's right.
records.en: Yes, that's right.

records.jp: 私はその力を使って私自身のフラグメントを<CR>オリジンに捧げ、世界を再構築しようとしました
records.en_original: I used that power to try to reconstruct the world by offering my Fragment to Origin.
records.en: I used that power to try to reconstruct the world by offering my Fragment to Origin.

records.jp: しかし、その目論見は阻まれて――<CR>今に至る、というわけです
records.en_original: But my plan was thwarted. ...And that brings us to now.
records.en: But my plan was thwarted. ...And that brings us to now.

records.jp: なるほどな……いや、全然分かんないけど。<CR>分かんないことが、分かった
records.en_original: I think I get it... Actually, nope, I don't get it at all. I'm lost.
records.en: I think I get it... Actually, nope, I don't get it at all. I'm lost.

records.jp: でも……そんなものがなんで、愛央の心の中に？
records.en_original: So... How did such a thing appear inside Ao's heart?
records.en: So... How did such a thing appear inside Ao's heart?

records.jp: 私も、それが分からないんです
records.en_original: That, I don't know either.
records.en: That, I don't know either.

records.jp: 私がここまで説明したことは、<CR>星崎さんの心の中にオリジンがある理由にはならない
records.en_original: Everything I've just told you still doesn't explain why Origin exists within Ao's heart.
records.en: Everything I've just told you still doesn't explain why Origin exists within Hoshizaki-san's heart.

records.jp: むしろ逆……余計に分からなくなるんです。<CR>考えれば考えるほどに、あり得ない状況としか……
records.en_original: If anything, it simply raises even more questions. The more I think about it, the more impossible it seems...
records.en: If anything, it simply raises even more questions. The more I think about it, the more impossible it seems...

records.jp: ココロトープの景色は<CR>あくまで思い出をもとにしたもの
records.en_original: The scenery inside the Heartscapes has always been based on memories.
records.en: The scenery inside the Heartscapes has always been based on memories.

records.jp: だから本当なら、あのオリジンとかいうのも<CR>いつかどこかで見たもののはず――
records.en_original: Then she must have seen this Origin somewhere before...
records.en: Then she must have seen this Origin somewhere before...

records.jp: お、オリジンを見た……？
records.en_original: She saw Origin...?
records.en: She saw Origin...?

records.jp: なら愛央ちゃんも、実は記憶を失ってるのかな……？
records.en_original: Maybe Ao really did lose her memory...?
records.en: Maybe Ao-chan really did lose her memory...?

records.jp: ……それかあるいは、<CR>誰かに心の中をいじられたりでもしたか
records.en_original: That, or someone tinkered around inside her heart.
records.en: That, or someone tinkered around inside her heart.

records.jp: そ、そんなことがあり得るの……？
records.en_original: I-is that possible?
records.en: I-is that possible?

records.jp: （それって、つまり……）
records.en_original: (That means, in other words...)
records.en: (That means, in other words...)

records.jp: 詩さん、みんなも、<CR>協力してくれてありがとう
records.en_original: Uta, everyone, thank you for your help.
records.en: Uta-san, everyone, thank you for your help.

records.jp: 私の方でも、少し考えてみるよ
records.en_original: I think I need a little time to think.
records.en: I think I need a little time to think.

records.jp: ……分かりました
records.en_original: ...Of course.
records.en: ...Of course.

records.jp: ……整理の時間は必要かもしれないね
records.en_original: I'm sure this is a lot to take in.
records.en: I'm sure this is a lot to take in.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en: Ao-chan...
